name: What is the difference between a water intrusion assessment and a general roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a water intrusion assessment and a general roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general roof inspection primarily focuses on the overall condition of your roofing materials and structure for maintenance or insurance purposes. A water intrusion assessment, however, is a specialized service specifically designed to identify and trace the exact pathways of water entering your building. While a roof inspection might flag potential issues, a water intrusion assessment provides a precise diagnosis of active leaks and their origins, often using advanced detection techniques.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general roof inspection assesses overall roof condition, while a water intrusion assessment specifically diagnoses active leaks and their entry points with specialized methods.
